stories.headline: Brazil's Federal Police freeze up to R$93 million in a Santa Catarina port-sector laundering probe tied to cocaine exports
stories.body: On 10 November, about 25 officers executed five search warrants in Itajaí and one preventive arrest warrant in Operation Recycling, a branch of the Operation Hinterland investigation. Investigators say a family of port and waste-management businesspeople laundered money for groups shipping Paraguayan cocaine to Europe via Brazilian ports, with over R$26 million withdrawn. Courts froze up to R$93.2 million, and 17 properties, five boats and more than 100 vehicles were seized; no drugs were recovered.
